Elise|jgl.identity: Two-form magic damage mage-assassin, an early gank specialist. In human form: Neurotoxin (Q) deals damage based on current health, Volatile Spiderling (W) rushes forward and explodes, Cocoon (E) stuns at range. In spider form: Venomous Bite (Q) deals damage based on missing health, Skittering Frenzy (W) speeds up her attacks and her spiderlings', Rappel (E) makes her untargetable, then drops her onto a target. Spider Form (R) swaps forms at any time.
Elise|jgl.playstyle: Aggressive early-game jungler: ganks from level 3, tower dives with Rappel (which drops tower aggro), and constant pressure. She loses impact if the game drags on: you have to build a lead early.
Elise|jgl.early_game: Clear fast by switching forms to use every ability. Gank at level 3 with Cocoon (human E): if it lands, chain human Q + W, switch to spider, spider Q and attacks. Rappel lets you dive under a tower and then dodge its shots.
Elise|jgl.level_1: Volatile Spiderling (W) first on the most played path. It helps on the first camp; you unlock both forms thanks to the ultimate being available from level 1.
Elise|jgl.level_2: Neurotoxin (human Q) / Venomous Bite (spider Q). Human Q → spider form → spider Q: big burst on camps and champions.
Elise|jgl.level_3: Cocoon (human E) / Rappel (spider E). First gank: Cocoon → human Q → human W → spider form → spider Q → attacks. Rappel lets you dodge an ability or dive under a tower.
Elise|jgl.level_6: Both your forms grow stronger with your ultimate's ranks, but your peak is mostly level 3 and the first dives. At level 6, your laners often have their ultimates: it's time for 2- or 3-man dives.
power_spikes: Level 3: ganks with Cocoon, among the best in the game.
First levels: tower dives with Rappel.
First completed item: enough burst to kill carries.
Mid game: picks on isolated targets.
Elise|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast clear up to level 3, then an immediate gank on the most favorable lane (opponent pushed up, no dash, no vision). Elise plays for tempo: ganks, dives, invades and Scuttle control. Rappel lets you drop tower aggro during a dive. Play Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons once you've built a lead. She scales worse: don't spend 15 minutes farming.
Elise|jgl.trading: Ganking: Cocoon gets blocked by minions, aim through a clear line; then the full combo of both forms. Skirmishing: Rappel to dodge the key enemy ability. Give up on it if Cocoon misses against a target with an escape.
threats: Tanky junglers who soak your burst (Zac, Sejuani).
Long games where your impact drops.
mistakes: Missing Cocoon by throwing it through minions.
Staying in one form and losing half your damage.
Farming passively instead of building leads early.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: You're both early-game junglers: be faster on ganks.
matchup_notes.Viego: Punish him early, before he scales.
matchup_notes.Graves: Avoid his invades and gank the lanes where he isn't.
matchup_notes.Talon: He's just as mobile and aggressive: don't fight him without a lead.
matchup_notes.Zac: He soaks your burst and counter-ganks from afar: save Rappel for his jump.

Elise|jgl.mid_game: Picks and tower dives with your laners. Turn every lead into a tower or an objective.
Elise|jgl.late_game: Picks on isolated targets with Cocoon. In teamfights, wait for the enemy CC and burst the carry.
Elise|jgl.ahead: Tower dive, take objectives and choke out the enemy jungler.
Elise|jgl.behind: Look for picks with Cocoon and play with your team: your impact drops if you wait.
Elise|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to build a big early lead through ganks and dives, then turn it into objectives.
Elise|jgl.final_tip: Always chain both forms' abilities: human Q, then spider form and spider Q.
